description.summary: Chicken marinated in Italian dressing, topped with cheesy artichoke dip, and baked. Six ingredients: chicken, Italian dressing, artichokes, mayonnaise, garlic, and Parmesan cheese. Can be assembled earlier in the day and baked when ready. Ready in under 30 minutes. Low-carb, keto, and gluten-free.

preparation.step: Marinate chicken breasts in Italian dressing a few hours to overnight.
Heat olive oil in non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Remove chicken from marinade and cook 2 minutes per side. Place chicken on foil lined baking sheet.
In a medium bowl, mix together chopped artichoke hearts, Parmesan cheese, mayonnaise, and garlic powder. Spread artichoke mixture evenly on top of chicken.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until juices run clear.
